items.title: Systems Engineering
items.description: Engineering of complex systems across requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration, verification, validation, lifecycle considerations, and multidisciplinary coordination.

items.title: Requirements Engineering
items.description: Development, analysis, decomposition, traceability, and verification of engineering requirements.

items.title: Verification & Validation
items.description: Planning and execution of engineering verification and validation activities to demonstrate that systems and designs satisfy defined requirements and intended functions.

items.title: Systems Integration
items.description: Integration of electrical, electronic, mechanical, software, instrumentation, and control elements into functioning engineering systems.

items.title: Electrical Engineering
items.description: Analysis and design of electrical and electronic systems using circuit theory, electronics, instrumentation, controls, power, signals, and related engineering principles.

items.title: Electrical Design
items.description: Development of electrical architectures, circuits, interfaces, schematics, component selections, and implementation documentation.

items.title: Circuit Analysis
items.description: Analysis of electrical circuits using fundamental DC, AC, transient, frequency-domain, and network principles.

items.title: Analog Electronics
items.description: Analysis and design of analog electronic circuits including amplification, filtering, signal conditioning, references, and interface circuitry.

items.title: Digital Electronics
items.description: Analysis and application of digital logic, digital interfaces, and digital electronic systems.

items.title: Signal Conditioning
items.description: Design and analysis of circuitry used to scale, filter, buffer, isolate, protect, and otherwise prepare electrical signals for measurement or downstream processing.

items.title: Instrumentation & Measurement
items.description: Selection, integration, and application of sensors, instrumentation, data-acquisition hardware, and measurement techniques.

items.title: Test Engineering
items.description: Development and application of test systems, test methods, procedures, instrumentation, fixtures, and analysis used to evaluate engineering hardware and systems.

items.title: Automated Test Equipment
items.description: Engineering of automated systems that stimulate, measure, control, and evaluate electrical or electromechanical equipment.

items.title: Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
items.description: Systematic isolation, diagnosis, and resolution of faults in electrical, electronic, software, instrumentation, and integrated engineering systems.

items.title: Reverse Engineering
items.description: Reconstruction and analysis of existing systems, circuits, interfaces, and behavior when modernizing or documenting legacy equipment.

items.title: Controls Engineering
items.description: Analysis and implementation of feedback, state-space, industrial, and electromechanical control systems.

items.title: Industrial Automation
items.description: Application of controllers, sensors, actuators, industrial communications, robotics, and automated equipment to industrial systems.

items.title: Programmable Logic Controllers
items.description: Programming, integration, troubleshooting, and application of PLC-based industrial control systems.

items.title: Robotics
items.description: Engineering and application of robotic systems including motion, control, programming, integration, tooling, and industrial automation.

items.title: Electric Machines
items.description: Analysis and application of motors, generators, transformers, motor controls, and related electromechanical energy-conversion systems.

items.title: Embedded Systems
items.description: Development and integration of microcontroller-based hardware and software for sensing, control, communications, and real-time engineering applications.

items.title: Sensor Systems
items.description: Selection, integration, calibration, and application of sensors and associated interfaces for engineering measurement and monitoring.

items.title: Data Acquisition
items.description: Acquisition, conditioning, digitization, processing, and analysis of measured engineering signals.

items.title: Industrial Internet of Things
items.description: Application of networked sensors, embedded systems, wireless communications, and data collection to industrial monitoring and engineering systems.

items.title: Wireless Communications
items.description: Engineering and application of wireless communication links, embedded radios, link behavior, and communication-system integration.

items.title: Navigation Systems
items.description: Engineering of positioning and navigation systems using satellite, inertial, electronic, and integrated navigation techniques.

items.title: Inertial Navigation
items.description: Analysis and application of inertial sensors, inertial navigation systems, error behavior, and navigation-state estimation.

items.title: Satellite Navigation
items.description: Analysis and application of satellite-based positioning, navigation, and timing systems.

items.title: Integrated Navigation
items.description: Integration of multiple navigation and sensor sources to improve positioning, navigation, and state-estimation performance.

items.title: CAD & Engineering Drafting
items.description: Creation and interpretation of engineering drawings, models, layouts, schematics, and technical design documentation using computer-aided design tools.

items.title: Engineering Documentation
items.description: Development and maintenance of technical drawings, specifications, procedures, reports, design records, and other controlled engineering information.

items.title: Configuration Management
items.description: Control and documentation of engineering baselines, revisions, changes, interfaces, and product configuration information.

items.title: Engineering Project Management
items.description: Planning and coordination of engineering scope, schedules, technical work, resources, risks, reviews, and deliverables.

items.title: Technical Leadership
items.description: Technical coordination, mentoring, design review, engineering decision support, and leadership of multidisciplinary technical activities.

items.title: Engineering Education
items.description: Development and delivery of engineering and engineering-technology instruction, laboratories, assessments, and hands-on technical learning experiences.

items.title: Curriculum Development
items.description: Design, assessment, revision, and implementation of technical curricula, courses, laboratories, and learning outcomes.

items.title: Laboratory Development
items.description: Planning, design, equipment selection, implementation, and continuous improvement of engineering and technical laboratory environments.

items.title: Engineering Research
items.description: Structured investigation, experimentation, analysis, documentation, and communication of engineering research questions and results.

items.title: Software Engineering
items.description: Structured development, testing, documentation, maintenance, and configuration of software used in engineering applications.

items.title: Continuous Integration
items.description: Automated software build, test, validation, and integration workflows used to maintain code quality and reproducibility.

items.title: Computer Vision
items.description: Processing and analysis of digital images for automated detection, recognition, classification, measurement, and related applications.

items.title: Mechanical Design
items.description: Design and analysis of mechanical structures, components, assemblies, interfaces, materials, and fabrication considerations.

items.title: Engineering Fabrication
items.description: Translation of engineering designs into physical assemblies through manufacturing, machining, woodworking, additive manufacturing, assembly, and related fabrication processes.
